name: talos
description: Autonomous issue-to-PR pipeline orchestrated by a Claude Code session. Supports multi-harness runners (Claude, pi, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, custom/local) and an optional planner role for epic decomposition. pi runs inline one-agent-per-turn without subagents. Validator, developer (worktree-isolated), QA, reviewer, security, and docs subagents drive GitHub issues through to merged PRs.
